label: meaningful
label_meaning: meaningful: built from the seller's own published schema

census.description: Per level, how many lines read at each point and how many witnesses each check told against.

memory.description: The series memory to send with the next episode.

reading.description: Per level, the FOUR reading of the whole response, the knowledge join of its lines: held (every check passed), denied, contested (told both ways) or unknown.

segments.description: Each paragraph or cue's source beside its English at each level, with the evidence for and against that English: glossary, untranslated, fit and module-rule checks as SignChain { for, against } witness sets and their FOUR reading.

translation.description: The English, in the request's own form: text, or a subtitle file in the source's format.

attribution.derived_from: the schema and example output the seller publicly lists there
attribution.status: unclaimed: the owner can claim or remove the matching listing on the discovery board
